candidates.counterparty_hypothesis: Breakout chasers and stop-triggered market orders push price outside the prior 6-hour (24x15m) range at bar k-2 or k-1, but fail to achieve price acceptance for N=2 consecutive completed 15m bars (k-1 and k close back inside the range) while aggressive taker order-flow flips toward the interior. Trapped breakout positions liquidate over the next 4h.
candidates.decision_delay: closed_bar_end_ms + 60000ms (1 full minute after 15m bar close)
candidates.formula: Let boundary_high = max(high_15m[k-26:k-2]), boundary_low = min(low_15m[k-26:k-2]), A15 = ATR20_15m[k], A1h = ATR20_1h[h]. For LONG (side=+1): min(low_15m[k-2], low_15m[k-1]) < boundary_low - 0.10*A15 AND close_15m[k-1] >= boundary_low AND close_15m[k] >= boundary_low + 0.05*A15 AND close_15m[k] > open_15m[k] AND signed_flow_ratio_15m[k] >= +0.04. For SHORT (side=-1): max(high_15m[k-2], high_15m[k-1]) > boundary_high + 0.10*A15 AND close_15m[k-1] <= boundary_high AND close_15m[k] <= boundary_high - 0.05*A15 AND close_15m[k] < open_15m[k] AND signed_flow_ratio_15m[k] <= -0.04.

stop_tp.stop_formula: excursion_extreme = min(low_15m[k-2:k+1]) for LONG else max(high_15m[k-2:k+1]); raw_dist = max(abs(close_15m[k] - excursion_extreme) + 0.35*ATR20_15m[k], 0.80*ATR20_1h[h]); stop = close_15m[k] - side * raw_dist

candidates.counterparty_hypothesis: When 4h price efficiency ER12 is low (<=0.30), directional trend traders overpay at the outer edges of the established 4h (16x15m) range. A completed 15m bar that tests the outer 20% band and reclaims inside on above-baseline volume and positive reversal taker flow captures mean reversion back toward the range midline over 4h.
candidates.formula: Require completed 4h ER12_4h[j] <= 0.30. Let H16 = max(high_15m[k-16:k]), L16 = min(low_15m[k-16:k]), W = H16 - L16, mid = 0.5*(H16 + L16). Require 1.2*ATR20_1h[h] <= W <= 4.5*ATR20_1h[h] and volume_15m[k] >= 0.90*SMA20_vol_15m[k-1]. For LONG (side=+1): low_15m[k] <= L16 + 0.20*W AND L16 + 0.22*W <= close_15m[k] <= mid - 0.10*W AND close_15m[k] > open_15m[k] AND signed_flow_ratio_15m[k] >= +0.02. For SHORT (side=-1): high_15m[k] >= H16 - 0.20*W AND mid + 0.10*W <= close_15m[k] <= H16 - 0.22*W AND close_15m[k] < open_15m[k] AND signed_flow_ratio_15m[k] <= -0.02.

stop_tp.stop_formula: raw_stop = (L16 - 0.40*ATR20_15m[k]) for LONG else (H16 + 0.40*ATR20_15m[k]); raw_dist = max(abs(close_15m[k] - raw_stop), 0.90*ATR20_1h[h]); stop = close_15m[k] - side * raw_dist

candidates.counterparty_hypothesis: During short-horizon volatility compression (ATR8_15m / ATR32_15m <= 0.82), the first bar attempting to break the compressed 3-hour (12x15m) range often lacks genuine participation (either sub-breakout volume or opposing taker flow) and closes back inside the range. Fading this premature expansion captures the return across the compressed range over 8h.
candidates.formula: Require ATR8_15m[k-1] / ATR32_15m[k-1] <= 0.82. Let H12 = max(high_15m[k-12:k]), L12 = min(low_15m[k-12:k]), A15 = ATR20_15m[k]. Lack of follow-through: (volume_15m[k] <= 1.35 * SMA20_vol_15m[k-1] OR side * signed_flow_ratio_15m[k] >= 0.02). For LONG (side=+1): low_15m[k] < L12 - 0.15*A15 AND close_15m[k] >= L12 AND close_15m[k] > open_15m[k]. For SHORT (side=-1): high_15m[k] > H12 + 0.15*A15 AND close_15m[k] <= H12 AND close_15m[k] < open_15m[k].

candidates.counterparty_hypothesis: When 3 consecutive completed 15m bars [k-3, k-2, k-1] exhibit heavy one-sided aggressive taker flow with above-average volume but decaying net price displacement per bar (absorption divergence by passive liquidity), and the next completed 15m bar k closes strongly in the opposite direction with supportive taker flow, late aggressive market orders are trapped and unwind over 8h.
candidates.formula: Over [k-3, k-2, k-1]: require sum(volume_15m[k-3:k]) >= 3.0 * SMA20_vol_15m[k-1], aggressive flow pressure (-side) * mean(signed_flow_ratio_15m[k-3:k]) >= 0.05, directional push (-side) * (close_15m[k-1] - open_15m[k-3]) >= 0.60 * ATR20_15m[k-1], and price impact decay abs(close_15m[k-1] - open_15m[k-1]) <= 0.85 * max(abs(close_15m[k-3] - open_15m[k-3]), abs(close_15m[k-2] - open_15m[k-2])). On completed bar k: require side * (close_15m[k] - open_15m[k]) >= 0.30 * ATR20_15m[k] AND side * signed_flow_ratio_15m[k] >= 0.0.

candidates.counterparty_hypothesis: The UTC [00:00, 08:00) Asian session sets a benchmark liquidity box. When European/early-US trading [08:15, 16:00] UTC extends beyond the completed Asian session high/low by >=0.20 ATR20_1h but fails to sustain a runaway trend (<2.5 ATR20_1h) and closes a 15m bar back toward the session box with confirming taker flow, dealer inventory rebalancing pulls price back into the session range over 12h.
candidates.formula: For each UTC day, once 08:00 UTC is reached, freeze S_high = max(high_15m in [00:00, 08:00) UTC) and S_low = min(low_15m in [00:00, 08:00) UTC). For completed 15m bar k with end_ms in [08:15, 16:00] UTC (at most 1 signal per UTC day per side): For LONG (side=+1): min(low_15m[k-1], low_15m[k]) <= S_low - 0.20*ATR20_1h[h] AND low_15m[k] >= S_low - 2.50*ATR20_1h[h] AND close_15m[k] >= S_low - 0.10*ATR20_1h[h] AND (close_15m[k] - open_15m[k]) >= 0.20*ATR20_15m[k] AND signed_flow_ratio_15m[k] >= 0.0. For SHORT (side=-1): max(high_15m[k-1], high_15m[k]) >= S_high + 0.20*ATR20_1h[h] AND high_15m[k] <= S_high + 2.50*ATR20_1h[h] AND close_15m[k] <= S_high + 0.10*ATR20_1h[h] AND (open_15m[k] - close_15m[k]) >= 0.20*ATR20_15m[k] AND signed_flow_ratio_15m[k] <= 0.0.

candidates.counterparty_hypothesis: After a multi-bar 4h directional trend (prior 4h efficiency ratio ER6 >= 0.42 and directional displacement >= 1.0 ATR20_4h), trend momentum stalls as ER6 decelerates or drops below 0.45 and two adjacent completed 4h bars (j-1 and j) fail to extend the extreme by >0.35 ATR20_4h while bar j closes in the reversal direction with supportive 1h taker flow. Late trend followers unwind over 24h.
candidates.formula: Evaluated at each completed 4h bar j (with matching completed 1h bar h where end_ms_1h[h] == end_ms_4h[j]). Require max(ER6_4h[j-3:j]) >= 0.42 AND (ER6_4h[j] <= ER6_4h[j-1] OR ER6_4h[j] <= 0.45). For LONG (side=+1): (close_4h[j-4] - min(low_4h[j-3:j])) >= 1.0*ATR20_4h[j] AND low_4h[j] >= low_4h[j-1] - 0.35*ATR20_4h[j] AND close_4h[j] > open_4h[j] AND signed_flow_ratio_1h[h] >= -0.02. For SHORT (side=-1): (max(high_4h[j-3:j]) - close_4h[j-4]) >= 1.0*ATR20_4h[j] AND high_4h[j] <= high_4h[j-1] + 0.35*ATR20_4h[j] AND close_4h[j] < open_4h[j] AND signed_flow_ratio_1h[h] <= +0.02.

costs.fee_basis: actual executed notional once per leg; adverse spread+slippage applied once via tick rounding; no double subtraction
costs.funding_sensitivity: Ex-post adverse 4bp and 8bp per touched UTC 8h boundary (+/-15s) and unknown-hourly stress scenario; never credited
